text:
Rory Bennett: Idea  run a week-long 'Gratitude Week' before the All-Hands: quick peer nominations, 5 micro-spot awards, and a gratitude stream in Slack. Starting thread to agree on process + intl ops.

Maya Patel: Love it. Quick Qs: budget per award? timeline? are nominations open company-wide?

Rory Bennett: $100 per award (e-gift or charity option). Nominations open Monday -> Friday noon, winners announced at Friday All-Hands. Yes company-wide.

Evan Cho: Are managers allowed to nominate direct reports? And anonymous nominations?

Maya Patel: Managers may nominate but mark relationship. Anonymous ok — but encourage named for follow-ups. Keep reasons short (one sentence + optional example link).

HR-Bot: Nomination form draft: https://forms.gle/gratitudeweek2026 (fields: nominee, nominator optional, team, one-line reason, example link optional, reward opt-in: e-gift/charity/shoutout-only)

Finance-Bot: Reminder: Finance needs final payout list + recipient emails before processing. Also check local tax thresholds for e-gifts.

Sofia Alvarez: I can help with intl logistics. Suggest default to e-gift for non-US to avoid VAT/customs; allow charity as non-taxable alternative.

Evan Cho: Can we make a simple rubric so reviewers stay consistent? e.g., collaboration (1-3), impact (1-3), company values (1-3). Average score picks winners.

Maya Patel: Agreed. I'll add rubric to form description and reviewer sheet. Also add a checkbox: "won in last 3 months" so reviewers are aware.

Rory Bennett: Who volunteers to review? looking for 4 people from People Ops + 2 cross-functional volunteers.

Sofia Alvarez: I can volunteer as cross-functional reviewer. Happy to help triage for intl edge-cases.

Maya Patel: I'll recruit one more reviewer from Growth; Evan, can you co-review on Friday 2pm?

Evan Cho: Yup, ping my calendar. I'll also make a winners slide template.

HR-Bot: Reminder scheduled: post in #general 2 days before close and morning of close. Also will DM nominators if form fields incomplete.

Finance-Bot: Action: once finalists chosen, post list here and tag @Priya for approval. We need payout emails and country for tax handling.

Rory Bennett: Action items:
- Rory: finalize form link + deadline message (today)
- Maya: add rubric + "previous winner" checkbox (today)
- Evan: slide template + review calendar invite (today)
- Sofia: confirm e-gift options by region (tomorrow)
- HR-Bot: reminders per schedule

Maya Patel: Also adding a "digital badge" and Slack emoji for winners. Low-effort, high-visibility.

Evan Cho: Great. Anything else? otherwise I'll draft the announcement for #general and schedule reminders.

Rory Bennett: That's it  thanks team. I'll post the form and announce Monday. :tada:
